'''Wang Dongming''' ({{zh|s=王东明}}; born July 1961 in [[Anhui]], [[China]]) is Research Director (Directeur de Recherche) at the French National Center for Scientific Research ([[Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique]], CNRS).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www-polsys.lip6.fr/Team/index.html |title=POLSYS Team |publisher=Polsys.lip6.fr |date= |accessdate=2017-09-07}}</ref> He was awarded Wen-tsün Wu Chair Professor at the [[University of Science and Technology of China]] in 2001,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://hr.ustc.edu.cn/cn/shizi.aspx?infotypeid=841300363437500032 |title=中国科学技术大学人力资源部 |publisher=Hr.ustc.edu.cn |date= |accessdate=2017-09-07}}</ref> Changjiang Scholar of the [[Chinese Ministry of Education]] in 2005,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cdgdc.edu.cn/xwyyjsjyxx/xwsytjxx/cjxzmd/265637.shtml |title=第六批特聘教授名单_长江学者名单_数据中心_中国学位与研究生教育信息网 |publisher=Cdgdc.edu.cn |date=2017-03-13 |accessdate=2017-09-07}}</ref> and Bagui Scholar of [[Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region]], China in 2014.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://gxrb.gxnews.com.cn/html/2014-02/14/content_930932.htm |title=广西日报数字报刊 |publisher=Gxrb.gxnews.com.cn |date= |accessdate=2017-09-07}}</ref> He was elected Member of the [[Academia Europaea]] in 2017.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Wang_Dongming |title=Academy of Europe: Wang Dongming |publisher=Ae-info.org |date= |accessdate=2017-09-07}}</ref>

Wang worked on algorithmic [[elimination theory]], geometric reasoning and [[knowledge management]], and applications of [[symbolic computation]] to qualitative analysis of differential equations. In 1993 he proposed an elimination method for [[triangular decomposition]] of polynomial systems,<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Wang|first1=Dongming|title=An elimination method for polynomial systems|journal=Journal of Symbolic Computation|date=1993|volume=16|issue=2|pages=83–114|doi=10.1006/jsco.1993.1035|doi-access=free}}</ref> which has been referred to as Wang's method and compared with other three methods.<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Aubry|first1=Philippe|last2=Moreno Maza|first2=Marc|title=Triangular sets for solving polynomial systems: a comparative implementation of four methods|journal=Journal of Symbolic Computation|date=1999|volume=28|issue=1|pages=125–154|doi=10.1006/jsco.1999.0270|doi-access=free}}</ref> Later on he introduced the concepts of regular systems and simple systems<ref>{{cite web|last1=Dellière|first1=Stéphane|title=D.M.Wang simple systems and dynamic constructible closure|url=http://www.unilim.fr/laco/rapports/2000/R2000_16.html|website=LACO – Rapport n° 2000–16|accessdate=4 September 2017}}</ref> and devised algorithms for regular and simple triangular decompositions.<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Wang|first1=Dongming|title=Decomposing polynomial systems into simple systems|journal=Journal of Symbolic Computation|date=1998|volume=25|issue=3|pages=295–314|doi=10.1006/jsco.1997.0177|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|last1=Wang|first1=Dongming|title=Computing triangular systems and regular systems|journal=Journal of Symbolic Computation|date=2000|volume=30|issue=2|pages=221–236|doi=10.1006/jsco.1999.0355|doi-access=free}}</ref> He also developed a package, called Epsilon,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://wang.cc4cm.org/epsilon/index.html |title=Epsilon 0.618 |publisher=Wang.cc4cm.org |date= |accessdate=2017-09-07}}</ref> which implements his methods.<ref>{{cite book|last1=Wang|first1=Dongming|title=Elimination Methods|date=2001|publisher=Springer-Verlag|location=Wien New York}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|last1=Wang|first1=Dongming|title=Elimination Practice: Software Tools and Applications|date=2004|publisher=Imperial College Press|location=London}}</ref>

Wang popularized the use of methods and tools of [[computer algebra]] for symbolic analysis of stability and bifurcation of differential and biological systems. He constructed a class of cubic differential systems with six small-amplitude limit cycles<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Wang|first1=Dongming|title=A class of cubic differential systems with 6-tuple focus|journal=Journal of Differential Equations|date=1990|volume=87|issue=2|pages=305–315|doi=10.1016/0022-0396(90)90004-9|bibcode=1990JDE....87..305D|doi-access=free}}</ref> and rediscovered the incompleteness of Kukles' center conditions of 1944,<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Jin|first1=Xiaofan|last2=Wang|first2=Dongming|title=On the conditions of Kukles for the existence of a centre|journal=Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society|date=1990|volume=22|issue=1|pages=1–4|doi=10.1112/blms/22.1.1}}</ref> which stimulated the study of Kukles' system in hundred papers.<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Christopher|first1=C. J.|last2=Lloyd|first2=N. G.|title=On the paper of Jin and Wang concerning the conditions for a centre in certain cubic systems|journal=Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society|date=1990|volume=22|issue=1|pages=5–12|doi=10.1112/blms/22.1.5}}</ref> Since 2004 he has been involved in research projects on geometric knowledge management and discovery. With co-workers he developed an algorithmic approach for automated discovery of geometric theorems from images of diagrams.<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Chen|first1=Xiaoyu|last2=Song|first2=Dan|last3=Wang|first3=Dongming|title=Automated generation of geometric theorems from images of diagrams|journal=Annals of Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence|date=2015|volume=74|issue=3–4|pages=333–358|doi=10.1007/s10472-014-9433-7|arxiv=1406.1638}}</ref>

Wang served as General Chair of [[ISSAC]] 2007 and is founding Editor-in-Chief and Managing Editor of Mathematics in Computer Science<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.springer.com/birkhauser/mathematics/journal/11786 |title=Mathematics in Computer Science – incl. option to publish open access |publisher=Springer.com |date= |accessdate=2017-09-07}}</ref> and Executive Associate Editor-in-Chief of SCIENCE CHINA Information Sciences.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.springer.com/computer/journal/11432 |title=Science China Information Sciences |publisher=Springer.com |date= |accessdate=2017-09-07}}</ref>

Currently he works as Professor at [[Beihang University]] and [[Guangxi University for Nationalities]], China on leave (détaché) from CNRS.
